purpose: Append-only point-in-time prediction record. Future labels must remain PENDING until the corresponding Hong Kong trading-session horizon has matured.
rules: Prediction payload is immutable after freeze.
Future outcomes are append-only and must not overwrite the original prediction.
No future label may be filled before its Hong Kong trading-session horizon matures.
Missing or unavailable point-in-time input stays missing; current data must not be backfilled into historical anchors.
A0 Champion and any Challenger records must remain distinguishable by model_version and rule_version.
Failed, WAIT and non-qualified predictions remain in the denominator and may not be deleted after outcomes mature.
